messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the Canadian national holidays that create long‑weekend breaks in 2023. (All dates are for the 2023 calendar year.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend Span |
|---------|-------------|-------------|-------------------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Jan 1 | Monday | Jan 1 – 3 |
| **Family Day** (Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | Feb 20 | Monday | Feb 20 – 22 |
| **Good Friday** | Apr 7 | Friday | Apr 7 – 9 |
| **Victoria Day** | May 22 | Monday | May 22 – 24 |
| **Canada Day** | Jul 1 | Saturday | Jul 1 – 3 |
| **Labour Day** | Sep 4 | Monday | Sep 4 – 6 |
| **Thanksgiving** | Oct 9 | Monday | Oct 9 – 11 |
| **Remembrance Day** | Nov 11 | Monday | Nov 11 – 13 |
| **Christmas Day** | Dec 25 | Monday | Dec 25 – 27 |

> **Note:**  
> • **Boxing Day** falls on Dec 26 (Tuesday) in 2023, so it isn’t part of a long weekend on its own.  
> • Some provinces observe additional holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, St. John’s Day in Prince Edward Island, etc.) that may create extra long weekends locally.  

Feel free to plug these dates straight into your holiday‑planning app!
